title: The product team owns the whole outcome

nodes.label: Execute within limits
nodes.detail: Implementation within contracts; tests, checks and maintained context

nodes.label: Accept and support
nodes.detail: Acceptance, release, production support and recovery

feedback: Review the evidence; decide what happens next.
textEquivalent: The product team owns the complete outcome. It defines the customer problem, scope and privacy decisions, then delegates implementation within agreed contracts, routine tests and checks, and maintained context. The team retains acceptance, release, production support and recovery. Evidence returns to the team to inform its next decision.
